fields.name: currunix
fields.doc: When the event happened: the settled instant, UTC.

fields.name: creaunix
fields.doc: When the event was created, where that is known; the earliest its chain knows once followed.

fields.name: execunix
fields.doc: The latest execution clock this lifecycle reached as of this event; an execution dates itself, following carries it, and duplicate statements keep their earliest observation.

fields.name: recdunix
fields.doc: When this event was recorded, where that is known; the earliest its statements know.

fields.name: exprunix
fields.doc: When the event stops being good, where it does; the latest its chain knows once followed.

fields.name: prevunix
fields.doc: When the event this one follows happened, where it follows one.

fields.name: snapunix
fields.doc: The grid instant a walk read this event as the snapshot of; empty on every row no snapshot was taken of.

fields.name: curruuid
fields.doc: The event's identity: UUIDv7 ordered by millisecond and sequence, with a content payload seeded by its cross hash.

fields.name: crossuuid
fields.doc: The identity every event of one chain shares, derived from the code they share; the event's own where it names none.

fields.name: crosscode
fields.doc: The code every event of one chain shares, as the event spells it; empty where none.

fields.name: currhashcode
fields.doc: The XXH3-64 of what the event states.

fields.name: crosshashcode
fields.doc: The XXH3-64 of the cross code; zero where the event names none.

fields.name: prevuuid
fields.doc: The identity of the event this one follows, where it follows one.

fields.name: seqnum
fields.doc: The event's place in its chain: how many came before it.

fields.name: srcuuids
fields.doc: The sorted unique identities of the elements this event was read from: provenance, never its chain - no walk moves it.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The state the event reached, as the code of a lifecycle-sorted enum; UNKNOWN where nothing states one, the furthest its chain knows once followed.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The line past its row header, as text: the edges stripped, the byte limit applied; never empty, because a line with no body is no line.

fields.name: msgthreadid
fields.doc: One row-header capture, read at the datatype its syntax matches; empty on every line the header declared it for and did not match.

fields.name: msgsessionid
fields.doc: One row-header capture, read at the datatype its syntax matches; empty on every line the header declared it for and did not match.

fields.name: msgctxid
fields.doc: One row-header capture, read at the datatype its syntax matches; empty on every line the header declared it for and did not match.

fields.name: msgseqnum
fields.doc: One row-header capture, read at the datatype its syntax matches; empty on every line the header declared it for and did not match.

fields.name: msgpluginid
fields.doc: One row-header capture, read at the datatype its syntax matches; empty on every line the header declared it for and did not match.

fields.name: loglevel
fields.doc: One row-header capture, read at the datatype its syntax matches; empty on every line the header declared it for and did not match.
